title: Refine paired-cube frames on PR168 v4 with retained terminal sinks (κ = 6.55920176686219e-4)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Refine 84 complex operation frames above PR168 at `4a3c769e5c5430e7114c4d3e099ff34664677f17`, retain its 47 terminal-output deletions, and independently certify the complete physical words and paid balanced composition. Under the retained interfaces, the bound is

$$
T(n)=O\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{655920176686219}{10^{18}}
=0.000655920176686219.
$$

This is +0.0047% over PR168 v4 (6.558894e-4), and supersedes my PR176 (6.48942e-4, built on PR168 v3). The complex branch binds.

The refined complex profile has 11,015 physical auxiliary roles, 13,655 persistent roles, rank mass 899,910, deficit 1,320 and largest child 20. Its saving is $656350690347/10^{15}$ (PR168 v4: $6563200/10^{10}$). Each of the 84 changes moves one operation, one equal-frame component or one connected bundle to an endpoint of its feasible interval (join of incoming frames and value span, or meet of outgoing frames); 29 are newly changed operations, 49 further change already modified operations and six restore compiler frames, so 15,172 operations differ from the compiler frames instead of 15,149. The 47 all-eight sinks of PR168's gate remain eligible on the refined layer; they are rechecked both by `research/terminal-sinks/sinks_gate.py` (in the discovery record) and by this package's own simultaneous target-chain checker. The unchanged PR168 v4 physical bit word has 21,548 persistent roles; its complete contaminated moment and established atom wrapper give ordinary saving approximately 0.000659615384. Scalar virtual stock, compensated handoffs, terminal deletions, the full orthogonal-group cardinality and all row reserves are charged separately.

The exact four-file PR175 overlay at `f1081fabbfadaaaaf7292a40d428dbbb865ce920` is retained in the verification baseline. Only compiler/source/derived-certificate hashes change; no mathematical field or emitted word changes.

No mathematical hypothesis or ordinary-supplier interface is strengthened. General Clifford/tensor, uniform weighted compilation, restored-row, paid-layout, precision/recovery and analytic fixed-tape contracts remain the stated assumptions. The finite certificate is not an unconditional multiplication theorem.

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial Anthropic Claude and OpenAI Codex assistance. The prerequisite construction is eumemic's PR168 v4, retaining its Anthropic Claude/OpenAI Codex disclosures and earlier PR144/161 lineage. Terminal-output accumulation is James Chang's PR166; balanced-layout, atom-toll and earlier supplier attribution remain in `research/paired-cube-refined-168/NOTICE`. PR154 supplies the isolated verification technique; PR175 supplies the exact compiler overlay.

## Validation

Validated exact commit `15e21dca486b4deacb07608d65021962e5e6086a` (tree `a397e694b7a42402c29e4b72319a9fb280c49951`).

- Complete original and terminal-modified complex words pass in both directions, including every source/target/dirty formal column and the full target-frame chronology. The modified word checks 13,655 columns and restores all 11,015 dirty roles; three corruption controls are rejected.
- The physical bit word passes all 21,548 F2 and defining-integer-decoder columns. All 24,601 used frame Gram witnesses preserve the retained prime range; word and factor controls are rejected.
- Exact supplier moments, full scalar/group/router/row formulas, all 47 strict inequalities and seven margins pass. Independent arithmetic reproduces the same bound with 30 rejected mutations; the package retains 21 assembly controls. Adjacent grid exclusions concern only the fixed certificates and parameters.
- The read-only aggregate reproduces the canonical certificate. `SOURCE.json` pins 1,699 files plus its own separately reported digest; every prerequisite file is retained except the exact four-file PR175 overlay.
- **Full repository gate: PASS. All 14 native verification groups plus the selected package passed in isolated copies of the published tree using the PR154 technique (Linux, 273.1 seconds); every source file remained byte-identical.**
- **GitHub CI: all 45 checks passed on the exact commit above, including the Python 3.11, 3.13 and 3.14 matrices and all formal checks.**

python3 -B research/paired-cube-refined-168/verify.py
